audit.why: Structural gap. Filled with verified late-game facts: Syndra R execute via Unleashed Power splinter upgrade, Yasuo R armor-pen crit window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart self-contradicts: all 7 full phases[].side read 'Yasuo' while content win[], the packet levelChart, and every phases[].why describe Syndra winning ('The lane is yours to bully'). breakdown.cooldowns has no digit. Two Do's/Don'ts bodies are pasted tradeGood/tradeBad strings.
audit.why: Row side and row why must agree; win[] and packet both say Syndra on every row, and the whys are written from a winning-Syndra perspective, so side is the wrong layer. Wind Wall is 25/23/21/19/17s with a 4s block; Yasuo E dash locks per target ~6-9s; R 70/50/30 needs an Airborne target — real numbers now in cooldowns.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side flipped to Syndra (win[] already agrees — no content edits needed per chart rule). Cooldowns rewritten with numbers. Bleed bullets rewritten to match their titles.

edits.before: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Scatter the Weak has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Wind Wall: 25s at rank 1, 17s max — it blocks projectiles for only 4s. Once it drops, you have a 20-second window where every Q, W and R lands; that window is the lane. - Your E is 15s: spent on poke, you are stunless for his whole next dash chain. - His R is 70/50/30s and needs a knockup — no Airborne, no Last Breath.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: His E cannot re-dash the same target for several seconds, so the chain has a rhythm — let hop one and two pass, then QE the predictable last minion-hop. The stunned dash is the kill window.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: R needs three-plus spheres on the field to execute — holding it for a perfect moment that never comes wastes the 120s cooldown. When he commits shieldless with Wind Wall down, press it.

Late, Syndra's upgraded R executes low-health targets, so a caught Yasuo dies through his shield; his R crits gain heavy armor pen after Last Breath, so she must never be the Airborne target that starts it.
